summary: A curated movie selection tailored for fans of atmospheric, emotionally resonant, and inventive storytelling like Radiohead and Amélie.

items.name: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
items.reason: Fans of Amélie and Radiohead will appreciate Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind for its imaginative romantic narrative, emotional depth, and melancholic atmosphere.

items.name: Dancer in the Dark
items.reason: Dancer in the Dark resonates with the dark, experimental, and emotionally poignant musical themes celebrated by Radiohead.

items.name: Donnie Darko
items.reason: Donnie Darko offers an existential, moody, and surreal tone that connects naturally with listeners of Radiohead.
